info.title: Shopify Admin GraphQL API 2026-10 (agent contract)
info.description: Every call is `POST /graphql.json` with a `query` and `variables`. The named request examples (also listed in `x-graphql-operations`) are the operations the agent should use; each is validated against Shopify's live schema for this version. Check `userErrors` on every mutation: Shopify returns HTTP 200 even when a mutation fails. Generated from operations.yaml by scripts/build_shopify_graphql.py; do not edit by hand.

x-graphql-operations.name: GetShop
x-graphql-operations.summary: Shop name, currency, plan and primary domain

x-graphql-operations.name: ListLocations
x-graphql-operations.summary: List locations (stores, warehouses)

x-graphql-operations.name: ListProducts
x-graphql-operations.summary: List products with variants, SKUs and featured image

x-graphql-operations.name: GetProduct
x-graphql-operations.summary: One product with all images and variants

x-graphql-operations.name: FindVariantsBySku
x-graphql-operations.summary: Find variants by SKU or barcode (search syntax, e.g. "barcode:0123")

x-graphql-operations.name: AddProductImage
x-graphql-operations.summary: Add an image to a product from a public URL

x-graphql-operations.name: ListInventoryAtLocation
x-graphql-operations.summary: Stock levels (available, on hand, committed, incoming) at one location

x-graphql-operations.name: GetInventoryItem
x-graphql-operations.summary: One inventory item with its stock at every location

x-graphql-operations.name: AdjustInventory
x-graphql-operations.summary: Change stock by a delta (e.g. +5 received, -2 damaged)

x-graphql-operations.name: SetInventory
x-graphql-operations.summary: Set absolute stock (e.g. after a count); changeFromQuantity guards against races

x-graphql-operations.name: ListInventoryTransfers
x-graphql-operations.summary: List stock transfers between locations

x-graphql-operations.name: GetInventoryTransfer
x-graphql-operations.summary: One transfer with line items and shipments

x-graphql-operations.name: CreateInventoryTransfer
x-graphql-operations.summary: Create a draft transfer between two locations

x-graphql-operations.name: MarkTransferReadyToShip
x-graphql-operations.summary: Move a draft transfer to ready-to-ship

x-graphql-operations.name: ReceiveInventoryShipment
x-graphql-operations.summary: Receive items on a transfer's shipment

x-graphql-operations.name: ListOrders
x-graphql-operations.summary: List orders (last 60 days unless read_all_orders is granted)

x-graphql-operations.name: GetOrder
x-graphql-operations.summary: One order with lines, addresses and fulfillments

x-graphql-operations.name: ListCustomers
x-graphql-operations.summary: List or search customers

x-graphql-operations.name: GetCustomer
x-graphql-operations.summary: One customer with addresses

x-graphql-operations.name: CreateCustomer
x-graphql-operations.summary: Create a customer

x-graphql-operations.name: UpdateCustomer
x-graphql-operations.summary: Update a customer (send id plus the fields to change)

x-graphql-operations.name: ListGiftCards
x-graphql-operations.summary: List gift cards with balances

x-graphql-operations.name: GetGiftCard
x-graphql-operations.summary: One gift card with its transactions

x-graphql-operations.name: CreateGiftCard
x-graphql-operations.summary: Issue a gift card (the full code is returned only here, once)

x-graphql-operations.name: CreditGiftCard
x-graphql-operations.summary: Add value to a gift card

x-graphql-operations.name: DebitGiftCard
x-graphql-operations.summary: Take value off a gift card

x-graphql-operations.name: DeactivateGiftCard
x-graphql-operations.summary: Permanently deactivate a gift card

post.summary: Run a Shopify Admin GraphQL query or mutation
post.description: Operations by area: Customers (ListCustomers, GetCustomer, CreateCustomer, UpdateCustomer), GiftCards (ListGiftCards, GetGiftCard, CreateGiftCard, CreditGiftCard, DebitGiftCard, DeactivateGiftCard), Inventory (ListInventoryAtLocation, GetInventoryItem, AdjustInventory, SetInventory), Locations (ListLocations), Orders (ListOrders, GetOrder), Products (ListProducts, GetProduct, FindVariantsBySku, AddProductImage), Shop (GetShop), Transfers (ListInventoryTransfers, GetInventoryTransfer, CreateInventoryTransfer, MarkTransferReadyToShip, ReceiveInventoryShipment).

200.description: GraphQL result. Errors appear in `errors` (query problems) or `data.<mutation>.userErrors` (business rules).

403.description: App lacks a required access scope or protected-data approval

accessToken.name: X-Shopify-Access-Token
accessToken.description: Offline access token from OAuth. Authorize: https://{shop}.myshopify.com/admin/oauth/authorize · Token: https://{shop}.myshopify.com/admin/oauth/access_token
